summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of its acquisition of a controlling 51% stake in Brazil's Brava Energia S.A. via a voluntary tender offer (OPAV) on B3 for 116,110,717 shares (~25%) and a share purchase agreement dated April 23, 2026 for 120,813,490 shares (~26%). Aggregate consideration was approximately US$1.2 billion, funded via an intercompany loan from Ecopetrol Capital AG. Brava holds ~459 mmboe proved reserves and produced ~78.8 kboed in H1 2026. The deal closed after regulatory approvals. Watch for post-closing integration and Brazilian operational performance.
